statement.en: This level is set in Winnipeg. In 1869 Canada took the vast northwest region over from the Hudson's Bay Company. The people living along the Red River were not consulted; Discover Canada calls them the 12,000 Métis of the Red River. Louis Riel answered with an armed uprising and took Fort Garry, the territorial capital.
statement.fr: Ce niveau se déroule à Winnipeg. En 1869, le Canada a repris à la Compagnie de la Baie d'Hudson la vaste région du Nord-Ouest. Les gens qui vivaient le long de la rivière Rouge n'ont pas été consultés; Découvrir le Canada les appelle les 12 000 Métis de la rivière Rouge. Louis Riel a répondu par un soulèvement armé et a pris Fort Garry, la capitale du territoire.

source.quote: the 12,000 Métis of the Red River were not consulted. In response, Louis Riel led an armed uprising and seized Fort Garry, the territorial capital.

verification.evidence: When Canada took over the vast northwest region from the Hudson’s Bay Company in 1869, the 12,000 Métis of the Red River were not consulted. In response, Louis Riel led an armed uprising and seized Fort Garry, the territorial capital.

blurb.en: Canada's laws are meant to keep order in society and to give people a peaceful way to settle a disagreement. They also put into words what Canadians value and believe.
blurb.fr: Les lois du Canada visent à maintenir l'ordre dans la société et à offrir aux gens un moyen pacifique de régler un désaccord. Elles expriment aussi ce que les Canadiens valorisent et croient.

source.quote: Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.

verification.evidence: Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.

name.fr: Musée canadien pour les droits de la personne

blurb.en: This is the Canadian Museum for Human Rights. In Canada the law applies to everyone. Judges, politicians and the police must follow the same law as you.
blurb.fr: Voici le Musée canadien pour les droits de la personne. Au Canada, la loi s'applique à tout le monde. Les juges, les politiciens et les policiers doivent respecter la même loi que vous.

source.quote: The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.

verification.evidence: Canada is governed by an organized system of laws. These laws are the written rules intended to guide people in our society. They are made by elected representatives. The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws. The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.

blurb.en: This maple has turned red again, the way the ones before it did. A legal system is handed down in much the same way. Canada's rests on the rule of law, freedom under the law, ideas of democracy, and due process.
blurb.fr: Cet érable a rougi de nouveau, comme ceux d'avant lui. Un système juridique se transmet un peu de la même façon. Celui du Canada repose sur la primauté du droit, la liberté sous le régime de la loi, les principes démocratiques et l'application régulière de la loi.

source.quote: Canada’s legal system is based on a heritage that includes the rule of law, freedom under the law, democratic principles and due process.

verification.evidence: Canada’s legal system is based on a heritage that includes the rule of law, freedom under the law, democratic principles and due process.
